verdict: The external archive preserves four useful but unadmitted real-view candidates beyond the repository set. They improve research coverage for aerial context, historical entrance continuity, scale and side-facade form, but their direct provenance and all member-to-way, numbered-building and road-linked controls remain missing. Formal membership, map, Hero/Identity lineage, MCP2 and MCP3 therefore remain blocked while accepted Massing MCP1 and diagnostic Three.js stages stay preserved without rerun.
